profile.description: Active Meagher County Labor Day Rodeo with vendors, mutton bustin', rodeo action, parade and street dance.

notes.subject: Explicit request for quote before next year's event
notes.body: The Meagher County Rodeo Club replied Aug. 13, 2026 that it was already booked with inflatables for 2026 but would love to get a quote prior to next year's event. Current official event information confirms the Labor Day Rodeo is active Sept. 6-7, 2026 with vendors, mutton bustin', rodeo action, parade and a street dance. Treat this as a strong 2027 invitation rather than a rejection.

followUps.label: Quote 2027 White Sulphur Springs Labor Day Rodeo early
followUps.reason: The organizer explicitly requested a quote before next year's event after already booking 2026 inflatables.
